assessments.comment: Independent inspection-only assessment of frozen source/history evidence, cohort remodnav-e3c6253bced7. No peer assessments or examples consulted. No network, payload acquisition, builds or scientific execution performed. Historical exit codes and README reproduction claims are attributed records, not independent reproduction. Scope includes numerical results, figures and manuscript and their explicitly linked computational inputs; upstream scanner/eye-tracker acquisition is not required to consume published recordings. Missing image/data/figure payloads limit verification; current retrieval and uniform access conditions remain unanswered. The documented containerized target also predates the assessed OCI image conversion, and its narrative acknowledges a visual difference from the journal. All nulls remain in fixed denominators; no extra credit for evidence volume.
